_comment: Drop this into .reasonix/settings.json to enable automatic session memory via reasonix-hooks (native Go binary). Install with: go build -o bin/reasonix-hooks ./cmd/reasonix-hooks

PreToolUse.description: Auto-retain meaningful tool context in Hindsight memory

PostToolUse.description: Retain bash command results in Hindsight memory

Stop.description: Auto-reflect on session in Hindsight memory
